title: AMLA Direct-Supervision Eligibility Estimator
description: Estimates AMLAR Art. 12 six-Member-State activity eligibility and per-Member-State materiality for the 2027 AMLA direct-supervision selection round. Provisional-eligibility verdict, gate-margin table, selection timeline. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: estimate_amla_direct_supervision_eligibility
mcp_tool_definition.description: Estimates whether a credit institution, financial institution, or CASP clears the AMLAR (Regulation EU 2024/1620) Art. 12(1) six-Member-State activity gate for the 2027 AMLA direct-supervision selection round: establishment-based presence always counts, freedom-to-provide-services presence counts only where per-Member-State activity is material (more than 20,000 customers OR more than EUR 50 million annual transaction volume, OR logic), home Member State always counts. Reports gate-margin detail and the selection timeline (selection begins 1 Jul 2027, supervision begins 1 Jan 2028), and discloses that final selection additionally requires AMLA residual-risk-profile ranking under Art. 13, not computable client-side. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/639-amla-direct-supervision-eligibility-estimator.html for interactive use.
